arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import uuid, datetime

now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
dtstamp = now_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
uid = f'{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill'

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART:20260803T020000Z
DTEND:20260803T040000Z
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting. Local time: Monday 2026-08-03 10:00-12:00 (CST, UTC+8).
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""
with open('project_kickoff.ics', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(ics)
print('Wrote project_kickoff.ics')
print('DTSTAMP:', dtstamp)
print('UID:', uid)
EOF
